output.reason: [ev-e477115a445b] says only that "the unused flag `sidecar-istio-proxy-image` has been removed". It does not say what happens to an environment that still passes the flag. Because the flag was already unused, "no longer honoured" doesn't fit: no working setting stops taking effect, so setting-ignored (which counts as mandatory work) is not supported. But the evidence also doesn't rule out a real failure, such as the 1.16 component refusing to start on an unknown flag, so "none" can't be settled either. To decide, we need evidence of what Cilium 1.16.0 does when it receives a removed flag: reject it and fail to start, or accept and ignore it.
